description: Comprehensive aviation edge case taxonomy based on NASA ASRS incident patterns and FAA safety data

safety_critical.name: Safety-Critical Incidents
safety_critical.description: Immediate safety threats requiring urgent attention

cases.name: Runway Incursion - Unauthorized Entry
cases.description: Aircraft or vehicle enters runway without clearance

cases.name: Runway Incursion - Failed to Hold Short
cases.description: Pilot fails to hold short of runway as instructed (27% of runway incursions)

detection_rules.missing_readback: hold short instruction without pilot readback
detection_rules.incorrect_readback: pilot reads back different runway number

cases.name: Traffic Conflict - TCAS RA
cases.description: Traffic Collision Avoidance System Resolution Advisory

cases.name: Altitude Deviation - Unauthorized
cases.description: Aircraft deviates from assigned altitude without clearance

detection_rules.readback_error: pilot reads back different altitude than cleared

cases.name: Wrong Runway - Lineup/Takeoff
cases.description: Aircraft lines up or takes off from wrong runway

detection_rules.runway_mismatch: different runway in clearance vs readback

cases.name: Go-Around - Late/Unsafe
cases.description: Go-around initiated late or in unsafe conditions

cases.name: Near Midair Collision
cases.description: Aircraft come dangerously close to collision

cases.name: Taxiway Incursion
cases.description: Unauthorized taxiway entry or conflict

cases.name: Emergency Descent
cases.description: Rapid unplanned descent due to pressurization or other emergency

cases.name: Loss of Separation
cases.description: Aircraft lose required separation minima

cases.name: Mayday Declaration
cases.description: Distress condition threatening immediate safety

cases.name: Pan-Pan Declaration
cases.description: Urgency condition affecting safety but not immediate distress

cases.name: Minimum Fuel
cases.description: Aircraft declares minimum fuel state

cases.name: Emergency Fuel
cases.description: Aircraft declares emergency due to fuel state

cases.name: Medical Emergency
cases.description: Onboard medical emergency requiring priority handling

cases.name: Engine Failure
cases.description: Engine failure or shutdown

cases.name: Fire Onboard
cases.description: Fire detected on aircraft

cases.name: Pressurization Failure
cases.description: Loss of cabin pressurization

cases.name: Hydraulic Failure
cases.description: Hydraulic system failure

readback_errors.name: Readback Errors
readback_errors.description: Incorrect or missing readbacks (33% involve speed instructions)

cases.name: Altitude Readback Error
cases.description: Pilot reads back incorrect altitude (most dangerous error type)

cases.name: Speed Readback Error
cases.description: Incorrect speed readback (33% of readback errors)

cases.name: Heading Readback Error
cases.description: Incorrect heading readback

cases.name: Runway Readback Error
cases.description: Incorrect runway number in readback

cases.name: Frequency Readback Error
cases.description: Incorrect frequency in readback

cases.name: Callsign Confusion
cases.description: Similar callsigns causing confusion or wrong aircraft responding

detection_rules.similar_callsigns: multiple aircraft with similar callsigns present

cases.name: Missing Readback
cases.description: Pilot fails to read back critical clearance

detection_rules.no_acknowledgment: clearance given but no readback follows

cases.name: Partial Readback
cases.description: Incomplete readback missing critical elements

detection_rules.incomplete_elements: readback missing altitude, heading, or runway

cases.name: Hearback Error - Controller Miss
cases.description: Controller fails to catch incorrect readback

detection_rules.incorrect_readback_accepted: pilot reads back wrong information, controller doesn't correct

communication_failures.name: Communication Failures
communication_failures.description: Radio communication problems and transmission issues

cases.name: Stepped-On Transmission
cases.description: Multiple transmissions overlap, blocking communication

cases.name: Garbled Transmission
cases.description: Transmission unintelligible or severely distorted

cases.name: Clarification Needed
cases.description: Pilot or controller requests clarification

cases.name: Radio Failure
cases.description: Complete loss of radio communication

cases.name: Frequency Congestion
cases.description: Excessive traffic on frequency causing delays

cases.name: Wrong Frequency
cases.description: Aircraft or controller on incorrect frequency

cases.name: Language Barrier
cases.description: Communication difficulty due to language proficiency

phraseology_issues.name: Non-Standard Phraseology
phraseology_issues.description: Deviation from standard aviation phraseology (biggest communication issue per NBAA survey)

cases.name: Non-Standard Terminology
cases.description: Use of non-standard words or phrases

cases.name: Missing Position Report Elements
cases.description: Incomplete position report

cases.name: Ambiguous Instruction
cases.description: Unclear or ambiguous clearance or instruction

cases.name: Missing Callsign
cases.description: Transmission without proper callsign identification

cases.name: Unclear Numbers
cases.description: Numbers not stated clearly using standard pronunciation

cases.name: Excessive Verbosity
cases.description: Unnecessarily long transmissions

cases.name: Homophone Confusion
cases.description: Confusion between similar-sounding words/numbers

environmental_conditions.name: Environmental & Special Operations
environmental_conditions.description: Weather, low visibility, and special procedure related issues

cases.name: Low Visibility Operations
cases.description: Operations in low visibility conditions

cases.name: Windshear Alert
cases.description: Windshear warning or report

cases.name: Icing Conditions
cases.description: Aircraft icing reported or encountered

cases.name: Turbulence Report
cases.description: Significant turbulence encountered

cases.name: Weather Diversion
cases.description: Diversion due to weather

cases.name: Thunderstorm Deviation
cases.description: Deviation for thunderstorms or convective activity

operational_issues.name: Operational Complexity
operational_issues.description: High workload, confusion, and procedural issues

cases.name: High Workload Indication
cases.description: Signs of high controller or pilot workload

cases.name: Airport Confusion
cases.description: Confusion about airport, gates, or parking

cases.name: Procedure Unfamiliarity
cases.description: Pilot unfamiliar with procedure or airport

cases.name: Complex Clearance
cases.description: Unusually complex clearance increasing error potential

cases.name: Student Pilot
cases.description: Student pilot operations requiring extra attention

cases.name: Unable to Comply
cases.description: Aircraft unable to comply with instruction

model_failure_modes.name: STT Model Failure Patterns
model_failure_modes.description: Common speech-to-text transcription errors specific to aviation

cases.name: Number Transcription Error
cases.description: STT commonly confuses aviation numbers

cases.name: Callsign Misrecognition
cases.description: Airline callsigns often misheard by STT

cases.name: Aviation Jargon Miss
cases.description: STT fails to recognize aviation-specific terminology

cases.name: Phonetic Alphabet Error
cases.description: NATO phonetic alphabet misrecognized

cases.name: Background Noise Interference
cases.description: Cockpit/tower background noise causing STT errors

sources: NASA ASRS Database - Runway Incursion Report Set
NASA ASRS DirectLine Issue 7 - Non-Standard Phraseology
Flight Safety Foundation - Communication Errors Study
Subang Airport B747 CFIT Accident Report 1989
